notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for consecutive ordinary receive-order attribute updates. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies adapter-supplied class and attribute lookups, publication, active subscription, object discovery, two ordinary Update Attribute Values callbacks in producer order, reflection metadata, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class lookup, publication, active subscription, registration, ordinary Update Attribute Values, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and receive-order reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ordinary attribute-update and FederateAmbassador reflection declarations
